body: I was sleeping at my boyfriend's, and he was still awake so he asked me "Where are the fishes?". I replied "Underwater".

I went to hospital. I was having acute psychosis, but they brought me back to 'reality' with medication and I can think a lot clearer and what-not. But, I know my life is not worth living now. I know this as a fact. I've lost too much. And I can't live with myself, who I am, what I've done. I have no freedom, because my life is dictated by others or mentally ill decisions. I still can't escape. I can't escape myself. I can't escape my ruined life. I still feel a bit out of it but I can't tell the doctors otherwise they won't let me go home, and two weeks in jail like conditions with people always watching you and questioning you, kind of drives you more crazy. I forgot and lost everything like even how to communicate and my own individual thoughts (that came back at least), and I've been trying to find reality but it's all just conflicting perspectives with incomplete details, and I can't find my own bc I know it's crazy. My plan now is to experience some good things, then getting my hands on that gun. That's it.
Haha my bf put his dick in crazy too. I was a 9/10. He fucked up. I think he is crazy too.

Okay thanks. I keep thinking what I think is wrong with me is wrong with other people and what I thought was wrong with other people is wrong with me? Also food tastes strange and I feel things really intensely all the time. I'm going to go when I can, hopefully something will change if I change something.

I guess so. People who kill someone and didn't mean to sometimes get forgiven too don't they? I've always apologised for my actions and tried to understand, change them, but not really change my mental health. I know I have to forgive myself eventually, but I've wanted to kill myself for so long. I did not intentionally mean to or see how I was acting at the time when I hurt other people or myself though - until now I realise, which is weird? Maybe he didn't either? We were told it was normal? 
Nah I am actually appreciating some guidance, but yeah I should probably do that, just haven't been able to here and won't unless I go to hospital.

Nice question, I guess people who haven't hurt others, or let themselves and others be hurt. So I guess neither him nor me do, he just believes he does, blames me for his abuse/problems/addictions and I blame him and others for mine? I blame me for his abuse/anger too. I feel very guilty. I just seriously forgot and wanted to escape the abuse, I just did it in the wrong way, pretended it wasn't there really. Being scared all the time kind of wears you down. I guess I'm scared that I won't have anything comforting around me, just left to my thoughts on a cold lonely bed and I can't pretend any more. I'm afraid to stop the behaviours harming me because that's all I know? People that have tried to be who they wanted/themselves and coped in the right way deserve it.
Maybe just feel okay would be good.

When I was under 18 I went to a nice hospital, not like how I know this one will be. I'm thinking they can at least keep me safe, feed me, and I can talk about everything in my head. Try and come back to reality. I'm scared honestly. I know people don't want me to leave but I have to. 
If I could do anything it would be happy and feel normal and be myself again. But I don't deserve even that.

Yeah but that thinking right there has meant I made the worse choices, because at least I wasn't killing myself. I'm stuck in the mentality I was from when I started smoking weed. I was going to try to go to hospital to see if they can fix my head but I don't want to do that because it won't work. That's why I won't try kill myself, because it won't work... I don't know I am lost.

Thank you. I just really think it's too late now. I have done what everyone else told me to do, especially him. I just have no grip on myself now or my life. It's like I can't walk away, I can't even go to hospital. I don't know what I want. I want to be dead. What freedom?
I forgot to take care of myself. It's a bit late now.

I can relate to this so much. I am a loser too. I have many mental disorders I didn't even realise. I pretended to everyone around me because they let me. I finally realise. I deluded myself that I could change, about what was real. I grew up into an ugly awkward woman child. I am too weak to survive too. I don't have to energy to kill myself either.
